Dasatinib (Sprycel(r)), a dual-Src family kinase inhibitor, and nilotinib (Tasigna(r)), a more potent BCR-ABL inhibitor, were approved for CML therapy in patients who were intolerant or nonresponsive to imatinib in 2006 and 2007, respectively.
